description: Upload a PDF, JPEG/JPG, BMP, GIF or PNG (up to 5 MiB) for a post-order entity. Returns documentId and Location; initial state is SUBMITTED. Publishing requires a separate eBay GraphQL mutation. Animated/multi-page PNG is unsupported; PDF page limits depend on usage. Requires commerce.post_order.document consent and keyset eligibility. Local file access is opt-in: the file must sit inside a directory listed in EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_DIRS (or under EBAY_MCP_MEDIA_ROOT, which also anchors media://<relative-path> references). Symlinks are resolved before the check.

path.description: Absolute path or media:// reference inside the media allowlist

name: ebay_upload_post_order_document
